answer: Fixed-pool dilution bond: the pool is fixed at 40,000, so each extra identity shrinks each share. Each identity locks 70 credit and files one juniper harvest claim. Fees climb a spiral curve: first 40, k-th 40+8(k-1). A gale audit re-checks a random tenth of claims; a rented-claim ring fails and burns its bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 4,036,000 in fees plus 70,000 locked, pool 40,000. Honest agents file once for 40 and keep the bond.
